_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Electronic Cost Reporting and Financial Tracking (ECRAFT) Labor Category List, and Contractor Crosswalk
summary: Establishes requirements for contractors to submit an Electronic Cost Reporting and Financial Tracking (eCRAFT) Labor Category List and Contractor Crosswalk, standardizing labor category reporting and aligning contractor labor categories with eCRAFT definitions.
use_relationship:
This DID establishes the requirements for the submission of the Electronic Cost Reporting and Financial Tracking (eCRAFT) Labor Category List, and Contractor Crosswalk by contractors. This DID is designed to standardize labor category reporting and ensure alignment between contractor proposed labor categories and government defined eCRAFT labor categories.

Applicability

This framework applies to cost plus fixed fee (CPFF), cost plus award fee (CPAF), and cost plus incentive fee (CPIF) level of effort (LOE) requirements and applies to contracts with at least one or more cost type labor contract line item numbers (CLINs). It excludes standalone firm fixed price (FFP) contracts.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Contractors must map their proposed labor categories to eCRAFT.

children.title: Section
children.content: Identifies the eCRAFT labor category grouping (e.g., ADMIN SUPPORT/CLERICAL, ENGINEER/SCIENTIST, etc.).

children.title: Code
children.content: Represents the eCRAFT unique identifier for each labor category.

children.title: Description
children.content: Provides the official description of the labor category as defined by eCRAFT.

children.title: Contractors must populate the "E2 Labor Category Codes"
children.content: inserting a labor category matrix column with their company specific labor categories that correspond to the (eCRAFT) "Description" Column "C" of labor categories listed in the template.

children.title: For labor categories with multiple levels (e.g., I, II, III, IV)
children.content: contractors must select the level that best matches their proposed individual and company specific labor category.

children.title: Summary
children.content: The DID ensures that contractors provide a clear and accurate mapping of their company-specific labor categories to the Government Standard eCRAFT labor categories.
